website.note: Public pipeline page partially out-of-date vs 10-K (KPL-387 lead asset).

pipeline.modality: Biologic (fully human IgG2 monoclonal antibody to IL-1R1, subcutaneous)

indications.trial_name: Phase 2/3 KPL-387 in recurrent pericarditis + transition-to-monotherapy supplemental Phase 2
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 dose-focusing portion of seamless Phase 2/3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; supplemental open-label transition Phase 2
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (Phase 2 portion); FDA Orphan Drug Designation Oct 2025; Phase 2 data expected 2H 2026

products.name: ARCALYST (rilonacept)
products.indication: Recurrent pericarditis (and CAPS/DIRA via Regeneron label)

excluded_preclinical: KPL-1161 (next-generation half-life-extended IL-1R1 mAb; preclinical, Phase 1 planned by end of 2026)
excluded_legacy_terminated: Abiprubart (KPL-404) — Sjogren's Disease Phase 2b discontinued Feb 2025; strategic alternatives being explored (NCT06531395 TERMINATED)
NCT05198310 KPL-404 in RA (COMPLETED, no further Kiniksa-led development)
Mavrilimumab (KPL-301) — GCA Phase 2 COMPLETED (NCT03827018); no active Phase 2/3 trial sponsored by Kiniksa; legacy COVID Phase 2/3 trials COMPLETED
Rilonacept (KPL-914) Phase 3 (NCT03737110) COMPLETED — supports approved ARCALYST product
excluded_partner_owned: Vixarelimab (KPL-716) — out-licensed to Genentech/Roche; Genentech sponsors clinical development

summary_counts.notes: KPL-387 in recurrent pericarditis is the sole active clinical-stage Kiniksa-sponsored program (seamless Phase 2/3); pipeline narrowed in 2025 with abiprubart discontinuation and reliance on commercial ARCALYST.
